thread:
acme-platform: Hey, we're seeing intermittent 422s from the /v1/chat/respond endpoint when using tool calls. Happening ~1-2x / 1000 requests. Example req id: req_0x9f3a. Payload included a function call; response sometimes has truncated `arguments` array.

jessica (Support): Thanks for the report — can you paste a raw curl we can use to repro, and the full request-id header value?

acme-platform: Sure. Here's the curl we used (token redacted). Note header: X-Request-ID: req_0x9f3a

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/respond 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -H "X-Request-ID: req_0x9f3a" 
  -d '{"model":"rw-ggml-13b","input":"summarize","top_k":5,"tools":[{"name":"extract_items","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"items":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}},"count":{"type":"integer"}},"required":["items"]}}],"tool_call":{"name":"extract_items"}}'
```

matt (Eng): Reproduced locally against staging with the curl above, I see the same 422 and schema validation failure: `ValidationError: additionalProperties not allowed at $.tool_responses[0].arguments` — but sometimes the response is fine. Sounds like partial payload cutoff.

jessica (Support): Can you paste the server-side log snippet for req_0x9f3a? Any truncated body or upstream chunking?

acme-platform: Pasting truncated logs — "body_read: 512 bytes, client closed" followed by 422 response. Full header block:

```
[2026-03-14T18:12:43Z] req=req_0x9f3a peer=10.2.1.45 method=POST path=/v1/chat/respond content-length=2345
[2026-03-14T18:12:43Z] read=512 total=2345 err="client closed" status=422
[2026-03-14T18:12:43Z] validation: tool_responses[0].arguments missing required field "items"
```

diego (SRE): That "client closed" looks like upstream connection or keepalive reuse issue. What transport are you using? Is there an HTTP proxy?

acme-platform: We're running through their internal proxy (envoy) that sits in front of our integration. No aggressive timeouts configured, but default keepalive.

matt (Eng): Two parallel hypotheses: 1) our runtime is streaming partial JSON when using function/tool responses and a middlebox sometimes cuts the chunk stream leading to truncated JSON, 2) client or proxy is retrying with truncated body. We need a reproducible curl that forces chunked transfer to replicate. Try this curl that uses --data-binary and Content-Length omitted to force chunked:

```bash
curl -i -N -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -H "X-Request-ID: req_0x9f3a-chunk" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data-binary @- https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/respond <<'JSON'
{
  "model":"rw-ggml-13b",
  "input":"summarize",
  "tools":[{"name":"extract_items","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"items":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}},"count":{"type":"integer"}},"required":["items"]}}],
  "tool_call":{"name":"extract_items"}
}
JSON
```

jessica (Support): acme, can you run that and attach the raw response body and the X-Request-ID header from their side? Also we need the debug bundle from the gateway for req_0x9f3a-chunk if it fails. Use "/support debug-bundle req_0x9f3a-chunk" — that'll collect per-request trace, tcpdump, and runtime logs.

acme-platform: Running now. Output shows the function call JSON ends with `]}` then connection reset. Raw snippet: `{"tool_responses":[{"name":"extract_items","arguments":{"items":["alpha","beta"` then connection reset and 422. Uploading debug bundle link: https://uploads.acme/rd-bundle-req_0x9f3a-chunk.tar.gz (private).

trace-bot: debug-bundle uploaded: rd-bundle-req_0x9f3a-chunk.tar.gz (size: 4.2MB). Assigned ticket #SUP-7521.

matt (Eng): Looking at the bundle — I see our runtime emitted a streaming chunk that split an array element across TCP packets which Envoy reassembled fine normally, but their proxy had `proxy_buffer_size` low and dropped mid-stream on connection reuse. That produced a truncated JSON on the origin. Repro steps: 1) run chunked curl above 2) force proxy connection reuse with repeated requests 3) observe truncated `arguments.items` array and 422 with schema error.

jessica (Support): Action items: acme — patch your envoy/proxy to accept larger buffer or disable connection reuse temporarily. We (Redwood) will add a guard in the runtime to emit a final chunk boundary and validate before handing off to the HTTP encoder.

acme-platform: Thanks, we'll try increasing buffer and report back. One more ask — is there a short-lived mitigation (e.g., turn off tool streaming) we can flip on while we patch?

matt (Eng): Yes, set `tool_streaming=false` on your requests to force whole-message responses. Example header: `X-Feature-Flags: tool_streaming=false`. That will avoid chunked partial JSON.

acme-platform: Verified with `tool_streaming=false` — no truncation observed in 10k requests. Thanks everyone, will keep this thread updated. :thumbsup:
